d: Dharti aaba bhagvan birsa munda ki 151vin jayanti ke pavan avsar par jharkhand ke mukhyamantri hemant soren ne unhen bhavpurn shraddhanjli arpit ki aur samast deshvasiyon va rajyavasiyon ko is gauravpurn divas ki shubhkamnaen din. midiya se batchit karte hue mukhyamantri ne bhagvan birsa munda ke yogdan aur unke vicharon ko yad kiya.
